name: Ponjo agent
about: Our own: a cloud model reads and proposes, and the program checks and applies. Runs on Node.js.

settings.label: Endpoint
settings.hint: The API's address: OpenAI's, OpenRouter's or another.

settings.label: API key
settings.hint: Kept encrypted by your system keychain.

settings.label: Read web pages
settings.hint: At a link in the thread or the doc, or on a page it read. Anthropic fetches them, not this computer.

settings.label: MCP server
settings.hint: A remote MCP server's URL, which Anthropic connects to. Any teammate who can edit can ask a buddy to use it.

settings.label: MCP token
settings.hint: Sent to Anthropic with each request, for the server. Kept encrypted by your system keychain.

settings.label: MCP tools
settings.hint: The names of the tools it may call, comma-separated: only those, so only read-only ones. None: no MCP.
